questions.question: Which HTML element is used to create a hyperlink?
Which CSS property changes the text color?
questions.explanation: The color property sets the foreground text color.

questions.question: Which keyword declares a block-scoped variable in JavaScript?
Which method converts a JSON string into a JavaScript value?
questions.explanation: JSON.parse() parses JSON text into a JavaScript value.

questions.question: Which HTTP method is commonly used to retrieve data?
questions.explanation: GET requests a representation of a resource.

questions.question: Which CSS layout system is designed for one-dimensional layouts?
questions.explanation: Flexbox is suited to one-dimensional row or column layouts.

questions.question: Which array method adds an item to the end of an array?
questions.explanation: push() appends one or more items to an array.

questions.question: What is the purpose of localStorage?
options: Store data only during a function
Persist key/value data in the browser
Send data to a server automatically
questions.explanation: localStorage keeps string key/value pairs across browser sessions on the same origin.

questions.question: Which SQL clause filters rows before grouping?
questions.explanation: WHERE filters rows before aggregation and grouping.

questions.question: Which tag is used for the main heading, typically the top-level heading?
questions.explanation: h1 represents the highest-level heading in a document section.

questions.question: Which JavaScript operator checks both value and type equality?
questions.explanation: === is strict equality and does not coerce types.

questions.question: Which Git command creates a local copy of a remote repository?
questions.explanation: git clone copies a repository and its history to a local directory.

questions.question: What does responsive web design aim to do?
options: Make pages adapt to different screen sizes
Require a separate site for every device
questions.explanation: Responsive design adapts layout and content to different viewport sizes.

questions.question: Which browser API can store small structured data as strings locally?
questions.explanation: localStorage stores string values by key in the browser.
